spec.hypothesis: Re-evaluate the exact previously declared complete bcap configurations against all five current Tier 1 requirements, including ring acquisition and paired five-word joint acquisition, under one frozen source and CUDA runtime.
spec.rationale: User-requested updated Tier 1 readout of existing configurations only. The finite recipe settings are the exact union of bcap-family-defaults-round1-v1. No new parameter combinations, seeds, host definitions, gate thresholds or task budgets are introduced. Earlier receipts retain their recorded source/view/runtime and are reused only for identical scientific task keys. All ordinary required failures stop the configuration immediately; every unknown and blocked requirement remains in the 5/19/2 denominator. Selection uses complete configuration PASS counts and the existing content-hash tie-break, confined to Tier 1. Quality and endurance stay unmeasured holdouts; provisional placement supplies no default adoption.

speed_selection.reason: No frozen comparable first-acquisition timing contract is implemented for this search. Not all required adapters record per-observation seconds; original terminal-suffix or coverage-only times cannot supply full-quality first-acquisition speed.
